note: Seed data: theses, analyst assessments (MODELING DECISIONS, not measured facts), milestone ladders, timeline events. Every assessment carries a rationale. Evidence URLs are included only where the source is stable and well-known; otherwise evidence_summary text is used.

execution.evidence_requirements: Mainnet producing blocks and accepting contract deployments. Block explorer or client release notes.
execution.title: Functional network exists

execution.evidence_requirements: Third-party developers deploying contracts; non-team user transactions visible onchain. DApp listings, explorer activity.
execution.title: Independent developers and users

execution.evidence_requirements: Trailing-30d user-paid fees (DefiLlama or equivalent) at a level that would rank the chain among top fee-generating networks; fees paid by end users, not validator self-dealing.
execution.title: Meaningful recurring fee revenue

execution.evidence_requirements: Onchain activity and fee revenue persist through a >12-month drawdown or after major incentive programs end, without collapsing >80%.
execution.title: Usage persists without heavy incentives

execution.evidence_requirements: Named institutions running production workloads that depend on the chain (settlement, tokenized assets, enterprise apps) — live operations, not pilots or announcements.
execution.title: External institutions operationally depend on it

execution.evidence_requirements: The chain is the default settlement/execution venue for its category by multiple independent measures (fees, developer share, tokenized value).
execution.title: Dominant execution layer

monetary.evidence_requirements: Genesis block / network launch; blocks propagating.
monetary.title: Functional network exists

monetary.evidence_requirements: Non-trivial holder base, exchange listings, peer-to-peer transfers beyond the founding team.
monetary.title: Independent users hold and transact

monetary.evidence_requirements: A >70% price drawdown occurs while onchain holder count, hash rate/security budget, and development do not collapse.
monetary.title: Survives a full market cycle intact

monetary.evidence_requirements: Public companies, funds, or sovereigns disclose the asset on balance sheets or in regulated investment products.
monetary.title: Institutional allocation as treasury/reserve asset

monetary.evidence_requirements: Priced and lent against broadly; used as a unit of account in real commerce beyond niche merchants.
monetary.title: Unit of account / widespread medium of exchange

monetary.evidence_requirements: Central banks or sovereign wealth funds hold it as a reserve asset class alongside gold/FX reserves.
monetary.title: Global monetary asset

oracle.evidence_requirements: Decentralized oracle network live, publishing price/data feeds consumed onchain.
oracle.title: Functional oracle network exists

oracle.evidence_requirements: Third-party protocols integrating feeds for production use (lending, derivatives, stablecoins).
oracle.title: Independent protocols consume feeds

oracle.evidence_requirements: Sustained fee payments from data consumers to node operators/stakers, visible in protocol economics disclosures.
oracle.title: Meaningful fee revenue from data consumers

oracle.evidence_requirements: Clear majority share of oracle-secured onchain value across chains; competitors have not displaced it over a full cycle.
oracle.title: Dominant share of oracle-secured value

oracle.evidence_requirements: Banks, market infrastructure, or enterprises using the feeds in production systems — live operations, not pilots.
oracle.title: Institutions operationally depend on the feeds

oracle.evidence_requirements: The network is the default oracle layer for tokenized global finance across asset classes.
oracle.title: Standard oracle infrastructure

payments.evidence_requirements: Ledger live and settling payment transactions.
payments.title: Functional network exists

payments.evidence_requirements: Payments by users beyond the founding team; wallet/exchange support.
payments.title: Independent users transact

payments.evidence_requirements: Recurring cross-border settlement volume attributable to the rail, disclosed by operators or visible onchain, sustained >6 months.
payments.title: Meaningful recurring settlement volume

payments.evidence_requirements: Volume persists after issuer incentives, rebates, or subsidized corridors end.
payments.title: Volume persists without issuer subsidies

payments.evidence_requirements: Named banks or payment institutions running production settlement flows on the rail — live operations, not pilots or MOUs.
payments.title: Institutions operationally depend on the rail

payments.evidence_requirements: The rail handles a measurable share of addressable cross-border payment volume in its target corridors.
payments.title: Meaningful market penetration

other.title: Instrument exists and functions
other.evidence_requirements: Token live; transfers, redemptions, or utility working onchain or via the issuer. Contract/explorer or issuer docs.

other.title: Independent users
other.evidence_requirements: Holders/users beyond the issuer; exchange listings; third-party integrations.

other.title: Meaningful recurring function
other.evidence_requirements: The instrument's stated function used at scale: redemptions honored at par, fee-payment demand, debt serviced, markets resolved.

other.title: Function survives stress
other.evidence_requirements: Peg defended through market stress, or function persists through a full market cycle without breaking.

other.title: External institutions operationally depend on it
other.evidence_requirements: Named institutions (treasuries, corporates, regulated products) depend on the instrument in production.

other.title: Dominant instrument in its niche
other.evidence_requirements: Default instrument in its category by multiple independent measures.

token_necessity.rationale: The token IS the monetary asset. There is no Bitcoin protocol without BTC; security, settlement, and the store-of-value thesis are all denominated in it.

token_value_capture.rationale: No cash flows, no burn, no staking. Capture is purely monetary premium on a credibly fixed 21M supply — works only if the SoV thesis holds.

world_impact_potential.rationale: A successful neutral global monetary asset would be among the most consequential financial developments in a century. Highest-impact category in the taxonomy.

events.title: Genesis block
events.evidence_summary: Satoshi Nakamoto mines the genesis block.

events.title: Bitcoin Pizza Day
events.evidence_summary: 10,000 BTC exchanged for two pizzas — first real-world purchase; earliest price discovery.

events.title: First $1k and crash
events.evidence_summary: Price exceeds $1,000 for the first time, then crashes ~80% — the first full boom/bust cycle.

events.title: Block-size war resolved
events.evidence_summary: Block-size dispute resolves via SegWit activation and the Bitcoin Cash fork. Thesis pivots decisively from payments to store of value.

events.title: Corporate treasury adoption begins
events.evidence_summary: MicroStrategy (now Strategy) adopts BTC as primary treasury reserve asset, starting corporate treasury adoption.

events.title: El Salvador legal tender
events.evidence_summary: El Salvador adopts bitcoin as legal tender — first sovereign adoption.

events.title: US spot ETFs launch
events.evidence_summary: US spot bitcoin ETFs approved and launch; record ETF inflows follow.

projects.launch_notes: Genesis block mined by Satoshi Nakamoto.
projects.measurable_success: Sustained demand as a long-duration store of value across cycles: growing holder base, deep liquid markets, institutional/sovereign allocation, and fee-paying settlement demand independent of speculation.

milestones.evidence_summary: Genesis block; network continuously producing blocks since.
Exchange listings, merchant adoption (2013-2014), millions of addresses.
Survived 2013-2015 and 2017-2018 >80% drawdowns with hash rate and holder base recovering to new highs.
Corporate treasuries (Strategy et al.), US spot ETFs ($50B+ AUM within a year), El Salvador sovereign holding.
Not a unit of account in real commerce; everyday payment use remains negligible.
No central bank holds BTC as a reserve asset class (as of 2026).

projects.name: Bitcoin
projects.thesis: Become a globally held, politically neutral monetary asset — digital gold — that preserves purchasing power over long horizons and settles finality without trusted intermediaries.

token_necessity.rationale: ETH is required to pay gas for all execution and to stake for network security. The protocol cannot function without a native fee/staking asset; only the ticker could theoretically change.

token_value_capture.rationale: EIP-1559 fee burn plus staking yield give direct value linkage, but L2s siphon execution and fee revenue is far below the 2021 peak. Capture is real but diluted versus the thesis.

world_impact_potential.rationale: The dominant programmable settlement layer for tokenized global finance would be foundational infrastructure — comparable to the early internet's TCP/IP layer.

events.title: Frontier mainnet
events.evidence_summary: Frontier mainnet launch; first programmable smart-contract blockchain at scale.

events.title: The DAO hack and fork
events.evidence_summary: $60M DAO exploit; hard fork to recover funds. Tests the 'code is law' thesis — community chooses intervention.

events.title: ICO boom
events.evidence_summary: ICO boom: Ethereum becomes the default fundraising and token-issuance platform.

events.title: DeFi summer
events.evidence_summary: DeFi summer: lending, DEXes, and stablecoins make Ethereum the center of onchain finance; fee revenue explodes.

events.title: EIP-1559 fee burn
events.evidence_summary: EIP-1559 activates fee burning, linking ETH value directly to network usage.

events.title: The Merge
events.evidence_summary: The Merge: proof-of-stake transition after years of delays. Issuance drops ~90%.

events.title: Rollup-centric pivot
events.evidence_summary: Rollup-centric roadmap formalized; L2s (Arbitrum, Base, Optimism) absorb most user activity while settling to L1.

events.title: BlackRock BUIDL on Ethereum
events.evidence_summary: BlackRock launches BUIDL tokenized treasury fund on Ethereum — institutional production use.

projects.launch_notes: Frontier mainnet launch.
projects.measurable_success: Majority share of onchain economic activity (fees, DEX volume, stablecoin settlement); enterprises and institutions building on or settling via Ethereum; sustained developer dominance.

milestones.evidence_summary: Frontier mainnet live.
Third-party dapps and the DAO; growing developer ecosystem.
Annualized fee revenue exceeded $10B at peak (2021); still the highest-fee chain by a wide margin.
Activity and fees persisted through the 2022-2023 bear market; no incentive collapse (Ethereum has no emission incentives for users).
BlackRock BUIDL and other tokenized funds operating on Ethereum mainnet; US spot ETH ETFs launched July 2024.
Faces credible competition (Solana, L2s fragmenting activity); not yet the undisputed default venue.

projects.name: Ethereum
projects.thesis: Become the dominant programmable settlement and execution layer for decentralized applications and tokenized value — the base layer others build financial infrastructure on.

projects.name: Solana
projects.launch_notes: Mainnet beta launch.
projects.thesis: Become the high-throughput execution layer for consumer-scale crypto applications — fast, cheap settlement for onchain trading, payments, and DePIN.
projects.measurable_success: Sustained high-retention consumer application usage (trading, payments, DePIN) with activity persisting independent of token incentives.

world_impact_potential.rationale: A successful consumer-scale execution layer would be major financial infrastructure, but the thesis is narrower than Ethereum's base-layer ambition.

token_necessity.rationale: SOL pays all transaction fees and secures the network via staking. No SOL, no Solana.

token_value_capture.rationale: Fees are intentionally tiny (a design goal), so capture leans on staking yield funded partly by issuance — dilutive. MEV adds some. Weaker direct linkage than ETH's burn.

milestones.evidence_summary: Mainnet beta live.
Serum, Raydium, Phantom wallet; 2021 bull-run user influx.
Trailing fee revenue in 2024 reached hundreds of millions annualized (meme-coin trading wave); top-3 fee chain.
Activity recovered and grew after the FTX collapse (Nov 2022) wiped out its largest backer — strong post-crisis retention without user incentives.
Institutions experimenting (Visa USDC settlement pilots 2023); no broad operational dependence yet.
Not the default venue; competes with Ethereum/L2s.

events.title: Mainnet beta
events.evidence_summary: Solana mainnet beta launches with proof-of-history consensus.

events.title: 17-hour outage
events.evidence_summary: First major network halt; several more outages follow through 2022-2023, denting reliability claims.

events.title: FTX collapse
events.evidence_summary: Largest ecosystem backer collapses; SOL falls >95% from ATH. Network and developers persist.

events.title: 5-hour outage
events.evidence_summary: Another network halt; reliability remains the open question on the thesis.

events.title: ATH near $260
events.evidence_summary: SOL peaks near $260 on November 6, 2021 — the top of the 2021 bull cycle, driven by NFT and DeFi activity; recorded on major price indexes.

projects.name: XRP
projects.launch_notes: XRP Ledger originates 2012 (first ledger closes June 2012); created by Ripple Labs founders.
projects.thesis: Become the bridge asset and settlement rail for cross-border institutional payments — the currency banks use to move value between corridors.
projects.measurable_success: Banks and payment providers using XRP itself (not just Ripple messaging software) for settlement at meaningful, recurring volume.

world_impact_potential.rationale: Capturing a share of global cross-border settlement would be highly consequential, but the thesis is narrower than a monetary asset or general execution layer.

token_necessity.rationale: XRP is the ledger's native bridge asset and spam deterrent, but Ripple's payment products have historically worked with minimal XRP usage; institutions can and do settle without it.

token_value_capture.rationale: Negligible fee burn, no staking, large escrow overhang (tens of billions XRP released programmatically). Capture is almost entirely speculative premium.

milestones.evidence_summary: XRP Ledger live.
Exchange listings and retail holder base established 2013-2014.
Ripple's ODL corridors reported volume, but independently verifiable recurring XRP settlement volume at meaningful scale has not been demonstrated.
No demonstrated incentive-independent settlement volume to evaluate.
Bank partnerships announced for years (SBI, Santander pilots); production XRP settlement dependence not demonstrated.
No measurable share of cross-border payment volume.

events.title: XRP Ledger live
events.evidence_summary: Ledger created by Arthur Britto, David Schwartz, Jed McCaleb.

events.title: 2017 retail mania
events.evidence_summary: XRP reaches top-3 market cap on speculation; settlement thesis unchanged.

events.title: SEC lawsuit
events.evidence_summary: SEC sues Ripple Labs alleging unregistered securities sales; US exchanges delist XRP.

events.title: Partial legal victory
events.evidence_summary: Court rules programmatic XRP sales are not securities; overhang lifts partially.

events.title: RLUSD stablecoin launch
events.evidence_summary: Ripple launches its own USD stablecoin — settlement can now route around XRP entirely.

projects.name: Chainlink
projects.launch_notes: Whitepaper published June 2017; token sale September 2017; oracle mainnet May 2019.
projects.thesis: Become the standard decentralized oracle infrastructure that smart contracts depend on for market data and offchain computation.
projects.measurable_success: Dominant share of oracle-secured value across chains, with node operators earning sustainable fee revenue from data consumers and major enterprise integrations.

world_impact_potential.rationale: Critical middleware for tokenized finance, but middleware: the largest value accrues to the applications and assets above it, not the oracle layer.

token_necessity.rationale: Node operator payments, collateral, and staking are LINK-denominated by protocol design. A different token is conceivable but the cryptoeconomics are built around LINK.

token_value_capture.rationale: Staking and explicit fee payments exist (Economics 2.0, BUILD/SCALE), but realized fee revenue remains small relative to FDV; most historical node payment was subsidized.

milestones.evidence_summary: Oracle mainnet live on Ethereum.
DeFi summer: Aave, Synthetix, and dozens of protocols integrate Chainlink feeds.
Sustained fee payments from data consumers; staking v0.1/v0.2 and BUILD program formalize the economics.
Secures the large majority of DeFi oracle value; competitors (Pyth, API3) have not displaced it over a full cycle.
SWIFT/ANZ (2023) and DTCC pilots demonstrate interest, but pilots are not operational dependence per the evidence rules.
Not yet the default oracle layer beyond crypto-native DeFi.

events.title: Whitepaper
events.evidence_summary: Chainlink whitepaper by Sergey Nazarov and Steve Ellis.

events.title: Mainnet launch
events.evidence_summary: Decentralized oracle network live on Ethereum mainnet.

events.title: DeFi summer integrations
events.evidence_summary: Becomes the default price-feed oracle for Ethereum DeFi.

events.title: Staking v0.1
events.evidence_summary: Staking launches in limited form after long delays — narrower than originally promised.

events.title: SWIFT/ANZ CCIP pilot
events.evidence_summary: Cross-chain interoperability pilot with major banks — pilot, not production.

events.title: CCIP general availability
events.evidence_summary: Cross-Chain Interoperability Protocol opens to all developers.

projects.name: Cardano
projects.launch_notes: Mainnet launch September 2017.
projects.thesis: Become a peer-reviewed, formally-verified smart contract platform for global financial and identity infrastructure — the academically rigorous alternative.
projects.measurable_success: Meaningful developer and user adoption of Cardano smart contracts, with real-world identity or financial deployments operating at scale.

world_impact_potential.rationale: Same category as Ethereum/Solana (execution layer), so the ceiling is comparable — assessed slightly below ETH given later start and narrower differentiation.

token_necessity.rationale: ADA pays fees and secures the network via proof-of-stake delegation. No ADA, no Cardano.

token_value_capture.rationale: Staking yield exists but is funded substantially by reserves/issuance; user-paid fee demand is small, so the fee-driven linkage is weak.

milestones.evidence_summary: Mainnet live.
Alonzo upgrade enables smart contracts; third-party dapps deploy.
Fee revenue remains modest versus peers; no sustained high-fee period demonstrated.
Activity base is small; incentive-independence not demonstrated at scale.
Ethiopia student-ID deal (2021) announced but never deployed at claimed scale; no operational institutional dependence.
Not a leading venue by any adoption measure.

events.title: Mainnet launch
events.evidence_summary: Cardano mainnet goes live after ICO-era development by IOHK.

events.title: Ethiopia deal announced
events.evidence_summary: 5M student IDs on Cardano announced — the flagship real-world deal; deployment never materialized at claimed scale.

events.title: Alonzo: smart contracts
events.evidence_summary: Plutus smart contracts activate, years after competitors.

events.title: DeFi struggles
events.evidence_summary: eUTXO model complicates DeFi; TVL and developer traction lag EVM chains.

events.title: Governance era
events.evidence_summary: Voltaire governance rollout shifts emphasis toward onchain governance as differentiation.

token_necessity.rationale: The token IS the product. There is no Tether without USDT; issuance, redemption, and settlement are all denominated in it.

token_value_capture.rationale: By design the token does not appreciate: 1 USDT targets $1. All economic value accrues to the issuer via reserve yield, not to holders.

world_impact_potential.rationale: If USDT becomes the default dollar rail for trade settlement outside the banking system, it is systemically consequential: a private dollar network at internet scale.

events.evidence_summary: USD-backed token issued on the Omni Layer.

events.title: Brief depeg to ~$0.85

events.title: NY Attorney General sues iFinex/Tether
events.evidence_summary: Alleges $850M shortfall covered with Tether reserves.

events.title: NYAG settlement: $18.5M
events.evidence_summary: Settlement without admission; Tether ordered to report reserves quarterly.

events.title: UST collapse triggers mass redemptions, all honored
events.evidence_summary: Over $10B redeemed at par in weeks; the largest real-world stress test any stablecoin has survived.

events.title: Supply crosses $100B
events.evidence_summary: Largest stablecoin by a wide margin; net profits among the highest of any crypto company.

projects.launch_notes: Launched as Realcoin in October 2014, rebranded to Tether; first tokens issued on Bitcoin via the Omni Layer.
projects.measurable_success: Peg holds through market stress with redemptions honored at par; supply grows across cycles; reserve attestations continue; settlement use extends beyond speculation.

milestones.evidence_summary: First USDT issued on Omni; transfers functional.
Listed across major exchanges; dominant quote currency; millions of holder addresses.
Dominant stablecoin for exchange settlement and DeFi; multi-billion daily onchain transfer volume.
Terra-collapse stress: roughly $10B of redemptions honored at par within weeks; peg defended through the industry's worst stablecoin stress test.
Cantor Fitzgerald custodies Tether reserves; USDT used at scale for trade settlement in emerging markets per company disclosures and onchain flows.
Not the default dollar instrument beyond crypto; banking rails still dominate real-world commerce.

projects.name: Tether
projects.provisional_reason: Stablecoin: the four core category rubrics were not designed for pegged instruments. Scored under the provisional 'other' category pending a dedicated stablecoin rubric.
projects.thesis: Be the dominant dollar-settlement instrument of crypto: a token redeemable 1:1 for USD, trusted enough that exchanges, traders, and real-world users settle in it instead of banks.

token_necessity.rationale: BNB Chain requires BNB for gas; the chain cannot run without it. Exchange-utility functions (discounts, launchpad) could in principle be cash-denominated.

token_value_capture.rationale: Auto-Burn destroys supply quarterly tied to chain activity; gas demand plus launchpad/venue demand create structural buy pressure.

world_impact_potential.rationale: A top-3 smart-contract chain plus the largest exchange's utility token; success means a parallel financial infrastructure at global scale.

events.title: BNB Chain (BSC) mainnet
events.evidence_summary: EVM-compatible chain with 3-second blocks; BNB becomes gas.

events.title: $570M BNB Chain bridge exploit
events.evidence_summary: Attacker mints 2M BNB via cross-chain bridge bug; chain halted, funds frozen.

events.title: SEC sues Binance
events.evidence_summary: Alleges unregistered securities offerings and commingled funds.

events.title: opBNB mainnet
events.evidence_summary: Optimistic-rollup L2 for BNB Chain goes live.

events.title: CZ pleads guilty; $4.3B settlement
events.evidence_summary: Binance settles DOJ charges; Zhao steps down as CEO.

projects.launch_notes: BNB token issued July 2017 alongside the Binance exchange launch; BNB Chain (BSC) mainnet followed September 2020.
projects.measurable_success: BNB Chain sustains top-tier fee revenue and active addresses across cycles; BNB demand tied to chain usage and venue utility rather than speculation alone.

milestones.evidence_summary: BNB issued; used for fee discounts on Binance from day one.
BNB Chain (BSC) mainnet; third-party developers deploy; non-team transactions visible onchain.
Top-3 chain by user-paid fees during 2021; fee revenue at a level ranking among the largest networks.
Activity and fee revenue persisted through the 2022-2023 drawdown without collapsing.
No named institutions running production workloads dependent on BNB Chain.
Ethereum remains the default settlement layer by fees, developer share, and tokenized value.

projects.name: BNB
projects.thesis: Be the gas and coordination token of the Binance ecosystem: BNB Chain's execution layer plus fee discounts and launchpad access on the world's largest exchange.

promises.text: With your help, Binance will build a world-class crypto exchange, powering the future of crypto finance.
BNB could be used to pay for any fees on the platform (exchange, withdrawal, listing), with a sliding discount starting at 50% in the first year.

promises.source_name: BNB Chain blog: A Journey to Decentralization
promises.text: BSC's goal is to develop an infrastructure for a DeFi ecosystem accessible to everyone anywhere worldwide with access to a computer or phone and internet connection.

promises.source_name: BNB Chain blog: A Journey to Decentralization
promises.text: As the network grows, the ecosystem becomes more independent and decentralized, resistant to malicious attacks and attempts to control the network.

promises.source_name: Binance (auto-burn announcement; exact blog URL not verified)
promises.text: Binance commits to burning BNB every quarter until the circulating supply is reduced to 100 million (the BNB auto-burn, replacing the profit-based burn in Dec 2021).

utility.notes: Fee run-rate ~$260M annualized from user-paid gas; TVL and fees are real network usage, not Binance CEX activity.

runway.emission_schedule: 200M genesis supply (2017); quarterly BNB auto-burn (since Dec 2021) targets 100M circulating supply; BEP-95 real-time burn destroys a portion of BSC gas fees.
runway.notes: Binance is a private company; no foundation treasury or burn disclosed. BSC gas fees accrue to validators, not BNB holders, except via the two burn mechanisms.

departures.name: Changpeng Zhao

key_people.name: Richard Teng

token_necessity.rationale: The token is the product. There is no USDC without the token; issuance, redemption, and settlement are all denominated in it.

token_value_capture.rationale: By design the token does not appreciate: 1 USDC targets $1. Economic value accrues to the issuer (Circle) via reserve yield, not to holders.

world_impact_potential.rationale: A regulated dollar rail could become default onchain cash for institutions and fintechs — the compliant counterpart to USDT's offshore dollar.

world_impact_potential.rationale: The dominant stablecoin-transfer chain is meaningful payment infrastructure, but a narrow moat: if fees rise or a cheaper rail wins, the thesis erodes.

projects.name: TRON
projects.thesis: Be the cheapest high-throughput settlement chain for dollar stablecoins: dominate USDT transfers with near-zero fees.

promises.text: TRON is an ambitious project dedicated to the establishment of a truly decentralized Internet and its infrastructure.
The TRON Protocol offers public blockchain support of high throughput, high scalability, and high availability for all Decentralized Applications (DApps) in the TRON ecosystem.
To build 'the blockchain's entertainment system of free content' through six development phases spanning 2017 to 2027, from Exodus (data liberation) through Eternity (decentralized gaming ecosystem).
TRON follows the philosophy of 'Decentralize the Web': the TRON public chain performs as the core of the TRON ecosystem.

promises.source_name: Justin Sun open letter to the TRON community (TRON DAO)
promises.text: A truly inclusive #financialinfrastructure that belongs to all mankind should be #unlimited, #decentralized, and #thresholdless.

utility.notes: Fee run-rate ~$294M annualized. TVL understates TRON's real utility: most usage is USDT transfers (payments), not DeFi TVL.

runway.emission_schedule: No hard cap; TRON has been net deflationary since 2023 as fee burns exceed block/witness rewards, driven by surging USDT transfer fees.
runway.notes: TRON DAO does not disclose a treasury or burn figure. TRX security is funded by transaction fees (energy/bandwidth model), not a disclosed budget.

departures.name: Justin Sun

token_necessity.rationale: A centralized exchange can discount fees in cash; WBT is a loyalty and staking mechanism, not a protocol requirement. Triggers the token-necessity gate.

token_value_capture.rationale: Staking tiers and burn programs exist, but capture depends entirely on one venue's fortunes (and is gate-capped).

world_impact_potential.rationale: A successful exchange loyalty token is a business win for one venue, not world-changing infrastructure.

milestones.evidence_summary: WBT issued; fee-discount utility live on WhiteBIT.
Adopted by WhiteBIT users; staking tiers active.
Fee-payment demand not independently verified at scale.
No independent stress test separable from WhiteBIT itself.
No external institutions depend on WBT.
BNB dominates the exchange-token category.

promises.text: Weekly buyback and burn: 33% of trading fees and 5% of other commissions used to buy back and burn WBT, until at least half of the 400M supply is destroyed.

utility.notes: No official usage/adoption metrics published; exchange-side numbers come from third-party aggregators.

runway.emission_schedule: Fixed max supply 400M WBT; no new tokens can be issued. Distribution: 54M private sale, 1M IEO launchpad, 25M burned at launch, 200M treasury unlocked over 3 years, 120M operational funds. Weekly buyback-burn of 33% of trading fees + 5% of other income targets destroying 200M WBT total; ~81.39M burned as of Aug 27, 2026. An 81.5M-token unlock occurred March 13, 2026 with little price impact.
runway.notes: Disclose-only: fixed supply + buyback-burn is the entire 'runway' story; exchange revenue figures are not published.
